closure.scope: Temporary CAD caps seal the intended tube outlets for this topology check; no physical leak test is implied.

source_hard_conversion.scope: Faceted recovery of the pinned STL, not the original author's analytic CAD or a physical fit measurement.

limits: Printed channel ends remain open for cleaning before tubes and flush plugs are bonded.
The metal tubes reinforce external fittings only; they do not bridge the deforming sensing channel.
Choose the tested actual stock dimensions and adjust socket/plug clearances before fabrication.
Holder-to-frame checks use conservative full envelopes; actual drive, hoses and clamps remain.
Bond and seal geometry does not demonstrate adhesion, leak resistance or 20 N performance.
A smaller bonded metal stem crosses the constrained frame region; the standard hose sleeve begins farther out.
Dimensions are procurement/fabrication targets and need actual stock and fit checks.
Static clearance does not establish loaded tube motion, bond strength, leakage or force accuracy.
The air-space topology check uses ideal solid/bond geometry; real resin, glue and tubing can leak.
The eight modeled PVC segments cover 3 mm engagement and 5 mm straight departure only; remaining hose routes need a measured slack loop.
Loaded motion and physical calibration remain.
